rule_hit_review.why: Primary text names Vitamin B12 without its concentration; advisory only.

tone_read: Calm, routine-led and educational; no fear or hype. The primary text repeats the headline line and the usage line awkwardly, which is a copy-polish point rather than a rule issue.
language_read: Product names and the 03% strength are written in brand format. The SPF 50 sunscreen and the 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA cleanser are named without product facts attached here, so SPF and strength could not be checked against a page.
